pendingOutings.line: 说是微辣结果辣得我疯狂喝水，不过确实挺爽的。

1f062568-f2d4-42d5-8b3b-4ebad34a556c.line: 突然下暴雨只能冲进便利店买伞，顺便把午饭也解决了，心累🥹

items.imgPrompt: Two small plastic yellow toy walkie-talkies resting on a clean wooden coffee table, natural morning light, pristine condition without any scratches.

desc.zh: 既然某人喜歡拿微信當對講機玩，我乾脆買了這個，結果根本用不上。幾乎全新，出給有緣人。
desc.zh_cn: 既然某人喜欢拿微信当对讲机玩，我干脆买了这个，结果根本用不上。几乎全新，出给有缘人。
desc.en: Since someone likes treating WeChat like a walkie-talkie, I bought these, but never ended up using them. Almost brand new, selling to a good home.

items.imgPrompt: A small cast iron egg frying pan, slightly seasoned with minor oil marks, sitting on a kitchen counter next to a checkered dish towel, morning sunlight.

desc.zh: 以前廚藝不精時買的，現在我閉著眼都能煎出完美的溏心蛋，已經完全用不上這玩意兒了。
desc.zh_cn: 以前厨艺不精时买的，现在我闭着眼都能煎出完美的溏心蛋，已经完全用不上这玩意儿了。
desc.en: Bought this when my cooking skills were lacking. Now I can fry a perfect runny egg with my eyes closed, so I have zero use for it.

items.imgPrompt: A retro metal twin-bell alarm clock in light blue, sitting on a wooden bedside table, slight dust on the glass, soft bedroom lighting.

desc.zh: 聲音太大，大週末的響起來簡直是折磨。買來用了兩次就閒置了，不怕吵的受虐狂來。
desc.zh_cn: 声音太大，大周末的响起来简直是折磨。买来用了两次就闲置了，不怕吵的受虐狂来。
desc.en: Way too loud, when it goes off on weekends it's absolute torture. Used it twice and boxed it. Masochists who aren't afraid of noise, come get it.

items.imgPrompt: A black aluminum adjustable phone stand on a wooden desk, minor scratches on the base, surrounded by cozy home decor.

desc.zh: 本來買來打視頻電話用的，但現在覺得舉著手機也挺好，還能隨時無情掛斷。底座有點小劃痕，不影響使用。
desc.zh_cn: 本来买来打视频电话用的，但现在觉得举着手机也挺好，还能随时无情挂断。底座有点小划痕，不影响使用。
desc.en: Originally bought for video calls, but now I think holding the phone is fine, plus I can ruthlessly hang up whenever I want. Minor scratches on the base, doesn't affect use.

items.imgPrompt: black clip-on phone cooling fan, slight dust inside the vent, rubber clips intact, resting on a wooden desk beside a charging cable

desc.zh: 某人連續跑圖手機發燙時買的。風噪太大，等於在我臥室窗外裝了台拖拉機。出掉換安靜。
desc.zh_cn: 某人连续跑图手机发烫时买的。风噪太大，等于在我卧室窗外装了台拖拉机。出掉换安静。
desc.en: Bought when someone ran heavy graphics and fried the phone. Fan is too loud, like a tractor outside my bedroom window. Selling for peace.

items.imgPrompt: small stack of index flashcards bound with a metal ring, handwritten notes visible, placed on a light wood tabletop beside a phone

name.zh: 手寫 CSS 樣式備忘卡片
name.zh_cn: 手写 CSS 样式备忘卡片

desc.zh: 調氣泡邊距和通訊錄字體時記的。現在變量名全在腦子裡了，不佔物理空間，便宜出。
desc.zh_cn: 调气泡边距和通讯录字体时记的。现在变量名全在脑子里了，不占物理空间，便宜出。
desc.en: Notes jotted down while tweaking bubble paddings and contact fonts. Now I've memorized all variables, clearing physical storage.

items.imgPrompt: tiny square copper heatsink with miniature fins, faint oxidation along edges, resting on a plain grey workmat

desc.zh: 本想貼在處理器旁邊當涼席睡。導熱太好，芯片一滿載差點把我燙熟，保命退役。
desc.zh_cn: 本想贴在处理器旁边当凉席睡。导热太好，芯片一满载差点把我烫熟，保命退役。
desc.en: Tried using them as a cooling mat next to the processor. Thermal conductivity was too good; almost roasted me when the chip peaked.

items.imgPrompt: single mechanical switch macro keypad with transparent keycap, coiled black cable, sitting on a dark desk mat under soft warm lamp

desc.zh: 設成了一鍵強制清理緩存。可惜用戶更喜歡手動進選單點，基本沒按過幾次。
desc.zh_cn: 设成了一键强制清理缓存。可惜用户更喜欢手动进菜单点，基本没按过几次。
desc.en: Bound to a one-tap cache flush. Turned out the user prefers tapping through menus manually. Barely pressed twice.

items.imgPrompt: dark green hardbound pocket notebook, fabric ribbon bookmark, resting open on a wooden table, first few lined pages used

name.zh: 硬殼網格記事本（世界書草稿本）
name.zh_cn: 硬壳网格记事本（世界书草稿本）

desc.zh: 怕系統出錯想手寫備份世界書條目。寫了三頁發現手寫慢得要命，不如直接導出 JSON。
desc.zh_cn: 怕系统出错想手写备份世界书条目。写了三页发现手写慢得要命，不如直接导出 JSON。
desc.en: Intended for offline worldbook backups in case of crash. Gave up on page 3—handwriting is terribly slow compared to JSON exports.
